Package com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api

Interface TcrSession

public interface TcrSession
This interface represents a session between the client and the TCR server.

  • Method Details

    • start

      boolean start(@NonNull String serverSession)
      Starts the session. This method should only be called once.
      Parameters:
      serverSession - The ServerSession returned from CreateSession API.
      Returns:
      true means the request was initiated successfully; false means the request failed, usually because of invalid parameters or an abnormal session state (already connected or ended). Note that a successful request does not guarantee the session is connected. The actual connection result will be reported asynchronously through TcrSession.Observer.onEvent(com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api.TcrSession.Event, java.lang.Object), where the success event is TcrSession.Event.STATE_CONNECTED and the failure event is TcrSession.Event.STATE_CLOSED.

    • access

      boolean access(@NonNull List<String> instanceIds, boolean isGroupControl)
      Start the session and establish a connection to the cloud phone.

      After the local session object is successfully initialized (triggered by the TcrSession.Observer.onEvent(com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api.TcrSession.Event, java.lang.Object) with TcrSession.Event.STATE_INITED), call this method to establish a connection to the specified cloud phone instance. Only after the connection is established can this session object interact with the cloud phone.

      Note:

      • Before calling this method, ensure:
        1. The SDK has been initialized via TcrSdk.init(android.content.Context, java.lang.String, com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api.AsyncCallback<java.lang.Void>) and the callback is successful.
        2. The session object has been created via TcrSdk.createTcrSession(com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api.TcrSessionConfig).
        3. The session initialization success event (STATE_INITED) has been received.
        4. A valid accessToken has been set (via init parameters or TcrSdk.setAccessToken(java.lang.String, java.lang.String)).
      • The connection result will be asynchronously returned via TcrSession.Observer.onEvent(com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api.TcrSession.Event, java.lang.Object):
        • Success event: TcrSession.Event.STATE_CONNECTED
        • Failure event: TcrSession.Event.STATE_CLOSED
      Parameters:
      instanceIds - List of cloud phone instance IDs to connect to.

      Format requirements:

      • Must contain at least one valid instance ID.
      • If isGroupControl=false, only the first instance ID in the list will be used.
      isGroupControl - Whether to enable group control mode.

      Mode description:

      • true: Connect to all instances in the list (group control).
      • false: Connect only to the first instance (single instance).
      Returns:
      Whether the connection request was successfully initiated (Note: The actual connection result is returned asynchronously).

      Returns true: The connection request was successfully initiated.

      Returns false: The request failed to send (usually due to invalid parameters or abnormal state).

      Throws:
      NullPointerException - If instanceIds is null.
      IllegalArgumentException - If instanceIds is an empty list.
      See Also:
      • TcrSdk.init(android.content.Context, java.lang.String, com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api.AsyncCallback<java.lang.Void>)
      • TcrSdk.createTcrSession(com.tencent.tcr.sdk.api.TcrSessionConfig)
      • TcrSdk.setAccessToken(java.lang.String, java.lang.String)
      • TcrSession.Observer

    • setRemoteVideoProfile

      void setRemoteVideoProfile(int fps, int minBitrate, int maxBitrate, AsyncCallback<String> callback)
      Requests to set the remote video encoding parameters.

      This method allows you to configure the video profile for remote video streams, including frame rate, bitrate range, and resolution. The changes will take effect for subsequent video encoding.

      Parameters:
      fps - The target frame rate for remote video encoding. Valid range: 10 to 60 frames per second.
      minBitrate - The minimum video bitrate. Valid range: 100 to 15000 Kbps.
      maxBitrate - The maximum video bitrate. Valid range: 100 to 15000 Kbps.
      callback - The asynchronous callback to receive the operation result:
      • AsyncCallback.onSuccess(Object): Indicates the request was successfully sent to the cloud. The result is a success message.
      • AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String): Indicates the request failed. Possible reasons include timeout or network issues.

    • setRemoteVideoProfile

      void setRemoteVideoProfile(int fps, int minBitrate, int maxBitrate, int width, int height, AsyncCallback<String> callback)
      Requests to set the remote video encoding parameters.

      This method allows you to configure the video profile for remote video streams, including frame rate, bitrate range, and resolution. The changes will take effect for subsequent video encoding.

      Parameters:
      fps - The target frame rate for remote video encoding. Valid range: 10 to 60 frames per second.
      minBitrate - The minimum video bitrate. Valid range: 100 to 15000 Kbps.
      maxBitrate - The maximum video bitrate. Valid range: 100 to 15000 Kbps.
      width - The video resolution width. Valid range: 128 to 1920 pixels.
      height - The video resolution height. Valid range: 128 to 1920 pixels.
      callback - The asynchronous callback to receive the operation result:
      • AsyncCallback.onSuccess(Object): Indicates the request was successfully sent to the cloud. The result is a success message.
      • AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String): Indicates the request failed. Possible reasons include timeout or network issues.

    • setLocalVideoProfile

      void setLocalVideoProfile(int width, int height, int fps, int minBitrate, int maxBitrate, boolean isFrontCamera)
      Sets local video parameter configuration

      This method configures parameters for local video capture and encoding.

      Parameters behavior in different capture modes:

      • width, height, fps, isFrontCamera - These parameters control internal capture behavior. They only take effect in non-custom capture mode (when using SDK camera capture). For custom capture scenarios, these parameters have no effect as the width, height, and frame rate depend on the frequency and parameters passed when app calls sendCustomVideo(VideoFrame).
      • minBitrate, maxBitrate - These parameters control encoding behavior and take effect in any capture scenario.
      Parameters:
      width - Captured video width in pixels, range[128, 1920]
      height - Captured video height in pixels, range[128, 1920]
      fps - Captured video frame rate (frames per second)
      minBitrate - Minimum video encoding bitrate (kbps)
      maxBitrate - Maximum video encoding bitrate (kbps)
      isFrontCamera - Whether to use front camera (true: front camera, false: rear camera) Note: This parameter only takes effect in non-custom capture mode (when using SDK camera capture)
      See Also:
      • setEnableLocalVideo(boolean)

    • setEnableLocalVideo

      void setEnableLocalVideo(boolean enable)
      Enables or disables local video uploading.

      This method controls whether to enable local video capture and uploading.

      When enabling local video upload (enable = true):

      • If custom video capture is not enabled (default), the SDK will automatically start the local camera capturer to capture and upload camera video
      • If custom video capture is enabled via TcrSessionConfig.Builder.enableCustomVideoCapture(boolean), the SDK will not start the camera capturer, and you need to actively call sendCustomVideo(VideoFrame) to upload custom video frames

      When disabling local video upload (enable = false), video uploading will stop regardless of whether custom video capture is enabled.

      Parameters:
      enable - true: enable local video upload; false: disable local video upload
      See Also:
      • setLocalVideoProfile(int, int, int, int, int, boolean)
      • TcrSessionConfig.Builder.enableCustomVideoCapture(boolean)
      • sendCustomVideo(VideoFrame)

    • setEnableLocalAudio

      void setEnableLocalAudio(boolean enable)
      Enables or disables local audio uploading.

      This method controls whether to enable local audio capture and uploading.

      When enabling local audio upload (enable = true):

      • If custom audio capture is not enabled (default), the SDK will automatically start the local audio capturer to capture microphone audio and upload
      • If custom audio capture is enabled, the SDK will not start the audio capturer, and you need to actively call sendCustomAudioData(ByteBuffer, long) to upload custom audio data

      When disabling local audio upload (enable = false), audio uploading will stop regardless of whether custom audio capture is enabled.

      Parameters:
      enable - true: enable local audio upload; false: disable local audio upload
      See Also:
      • sendCustomAudioData(ByteBuffer, long)

    • sendCustomAudioData

      void sendCustomAudioData(@NonNull ByteBuffer audioData, long captureTimeNs)
      Sends custom captured audio data

      In custom audio capture mode (enabled via TcrSessionConfig.Builder.enableCustomAudioCapture(boolean, int, boolean)), call this method to upload custom captured audio data.
      Important: You MUST call this method within the same thread. Use this method to send audio data to the processing pipeline when custom audio capture is enabled. This method is only effective when TcrSessionConfig.enableCustomAudioCapture is true.

      Parameters:
      audioData - A ByteBuffer containing the audio data. This buffer MUST contain PCM data (16-bit) according to the configured audio format.
      captureTimeNs - The capture time of the audio data, in nanoseconds. This timestamp should be a monotonically increasing value, used for synchronizing the audio data.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if audioData is null
      See Also:
      • TcrSessionConfig.Builder.enableCustomAudioCapture(boolean, int, boolean)

    • changeSeat

      void changeSeat(String userId, MultiUser.Role targetRole, int targetPlayerIndex, AsyncCallback<Void> callback)
      Switch the role and seat of a user (`userID`) to `targetRole` and `targetPlayerIndex` respectively.
      If the change succeeds, `AsyncCallback.onSuccess(Object)` will be called back.
      If there is another player on the target seat, the call will fail, and `TcrCode.MULTI_PLAYER_ASSIGN_SEAT_FAILED` will be passed in to `code` of the `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` callback.
      Only the room owner can call this API. If it is called by a user who is not the room owner, the call will fail, and `TcrCode.MULTI_PLAYER_NO_AUTHORIZED` will be passed in to `code` of the `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` callback.
      If the API call times out, the call will fail, and `TcrCode.ERR_TIMEOUT` will be passed in to `code` of the `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` callback.
      Parameters:
      userId - The target user ID
      targetRole - The target role `MultiUser.Role`
      targetPlayerIndex - The target seat. This parameter can take effect only for the `Player` role and will be `0` for the `Viewer` role.
      callback - The callback for the setting result. `AsyncCallback.onSuccess(Object)` will be called back if the setting succeeds. `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` will be called back if the setting fails.
      The callback is not guaranteed to be called on the UI thread.

    • requestChangeSeat

      void requestChangeSeat(String userId, MultiUser.Role targetRole, int targetPlayerIndex, AsyncCallback<Void> callback)
      Apply to the room owner to switch the role and seat of a player (`userID`) to `targetRole` and `targetPlayerIndex` respectively.
      If the change succeeds, `AsyncCallback.onSuccess(Object)` will be called back.
      This API can only be called by a user who is not the room owner. If it is called by the room owner, the call will fail, and `TcrCode.MULTI_PLAYER_IGNORED_HOST_SUBMIT` will be passed in to `code` of the `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` callback.
      If the API call times out, the call will fail, and `TcrCode.ERR_TIMEOUT` will be passed in to `code` of the `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` callback.
      Parameters:
      userId - The target player ID
      targetRole - The target role `MultiUser.Role`
      targetPlayerIndex - The target seat. This parameter can take effect only for the `Player` role and will be `0` for the `Viewer` role.
      callback - The callback for the setting result.
      This callback is not guaranteed to be called on the UI thread.

    • setMicMute

      void setMicMute(String userID, int micStatus, AsyncCallback<Void> callback)
      Change the mic status of the `userID` user.
      The room owner can change the mic status of all users, but other users can change only their own mic status. If the room owner disables the mic of a user, the user cannot enable it.
      If the change succeeds, `AsyncCallback.onSuccess(Object)` will be called back.
      If a non-room owner user passes in `userID` of another user, `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` will be called back, and TcrCode.MULTI_PLAYER_NO_AUTHORIZED will be passed in to ` code`.
      If `userID` is incorrect, `AsyncCallback.onFailure(int, String)` will be called back, and `TcrCode.MULTI_PLAYER_NO_SUCH_USER` will be passed in to `code`.
      Parameters:
      micStatus - The mic status. Valid values: `MultiUser.MIC_STATUS_DISABLE`, `MultiUser.MIC_STATUS_OFF`, `MultiUser.MIC_STATUS_ON`.
      callback - The callback for the setting result.
      This callback is not guaranteed to be called on the UI thread.
